0022600156.text: The Warriors (3-3, on a three-game winning streak and 1-1 at home) host the LA Clippers (1-4, on a four-game losing streak) in Golden State's seventh game of the season, with the Warriors second in the Pacific, one game back, and the Clippers fourth, 2.5 games back. Golden State is missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), while Los Angeles is without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 115-110 loss in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
